A solidarity contribution on profits (CS: A solidarity contribution on profits (CSS) applies on top of company income tax when net taxable profit reaches 1,000,000 MAD: the rate rises by band from 1.5% to 5% (1.5% up to 5 million, 2.5% up to 10 million, 3.5% up to 40 million, 5% above) and is not deductible; the 2026 Finance Law extended it through 2028.
